meta.purpose: Per-athlete one-time measurements the VALD DynaMo API does not capture. Feeds the body-mass-normalized peak-torque metric (torque = peak force N x lever arm m). Joined to VALD data by athlete name.
meta.forearmMethod: Floor to the middle of the DynaMo pad, measured in inches, with the elbow flush to the floor. The elbow-on-floor is the rotation axis, so this is a true ER/IR moment arm.
meta.note: Axis confirmed (Frank, 2026-07-14): elbow is flush to the floor every test, so floor-to-pad is a valid moment arm. Torque = peak force (N) x forearmMeters.
